goal: Oakhaven and Ironhold form one seamlessly streamed world with simulation LOD, authored content flows through six editor tools, cinematics run on skippable timelines with a defined camera language, and telemetry, crash reporting, localization and an accessibility baseline are in place for the public demo year.
exit_criteria: Walking R1 -> seam -> R2 at sprint never exceeds 2 ms of streaming cost per frame (CI traversal bot + manual real-renderer check)
Ironhold runs as RegionBase chunks; Act 1 bot completes in the streamed world; no ColorRect world geometry in R1/R2 (lint)
Sim LOD: active-vs-distant determinism test and the 7-day two-region run pass in CI
Quest editor (with timing fields), schedule editor, item/recipe editor, economy dashboard, storyline coverage viewer and difficulty panel each have a doc and a tool test
Telemetry and crash reporting are opt-in, write nothing without consent (test), and the endpoint decision is an ADR
All Act 1 .dlg lines have IDs; pseudo-loc screenshots clean; zh-CN sample renders with no missing glyphs
Accessibility baseline options implemented and reviewed with screenshots
Chapter 1-2 key cinematics run on timelines with skip tests; cutscene_director/cinematic_camera no longer used by Chapters 1-2

tasks.title: Write the world streaming ADR
tasks.why: §12.5 one continuous streamed world; budgets: streaming hitches < 2 ms

steps: /architecture-decision 'World streaming': world grid of 32x32-tile chunks across regions, global chunk coordinates, region = a named rectangle of chunks
Decide load radius (proposal 1 ring visible + 1 ring preload), unload hysteresis, threaded loading via ResourceLoader.load_threaded_request, max 1 chunk instantiation per frame
Decide simulation LOD tiers: active (on-screen), near (loaded, off-screen), far (unloaded, schedule-only), distant town (coarse tick every in-game hour)
Budgets: hitch < 2 ms per frame from streaming, N simulated NPCs per chunk (proposal 8), memory ceiling per loaded ring
